disclaimer: Not an official DeepSeek standard, not a certification of any DSH level, not a security audit, and not a legal GB / GB-T / GB-Z instrument. The GB analogy in the standards repository is a communication aid only.

canonical.note: The canonical repository is a private draft at the time of writing, so the public link may not resolve yet. Re-read the pointer before changing this file.

level.assignedBy: the standards repository, not this one

strengthVocabulary.necessary-not-sufficient: supplies a precondition a claim needs, and cannot produce the level state
strengthVocabulary.supporting-not-sufficient: supplies an input to a gate without any verdict
strengthVocabulary.context-only: governance context; feeds no level and no gate
strengthVocabulary.certification-precondition-not-an-entry-: a condition of this repository's own policy, not a requirement of the level

readingRules: A dimension's levels array means relevance, not coverage; coverage is defined by levels[*].coveredBy.
feedsGates never means a gate passes; every gate verdict recorded here is not-run.
Nothing in this file is evidence: evidence lives in data/attestations.json with a snapshot date.

manifest.label: A. Manifest compliance
proves: at the snapshot date the package declares a dsh bundle manifest, an SPDX license, aligned keywords/topics, five-language READMEs and an engines range

feedsGates.note: a dsh.bundle manifest is declared; the patch document itself is not parsed
the declared engines range is an input; evaluatePluginCompatibility is not run here

doesNotProve: G1: base + sample compose and inserted row names resolve
G2: the host admits the plugin
G3: real boot reaches ACTIVE/disabled rows
G4: exports['./client'] and a package-root row

buildHygiene.label: B. Build hygiene
proves: the published package surface is deliberate (files allowlist, peer/optional dependency declarations), no known malicious install-time pattern is present, and lint/typecheck gates exist

feedsGates.note: a complete files allowlist is an input to row/file resolution; composition is not run
declared peer/optional ranges are inputs; the host verdict is not run

doesNotProve: that the allowlist covers every file a patch references (G1)
that the declared ranges admit the recorded host (G2)
that install scripts are harmless (pattern match, not execution)

supplyChain.label: C. Supply chain
proves: the upstream repository's posture on the 18 OpenSSF Scorecard checks, as measured by the Scorecard service on its run date
doesNotProve: plugin behaviour at load or run

releaseIntegrity.label: D. Release integrity
proves: the published artifact carries verifiable SLSA provenance from a CI identity (npm audit signatures) at the snapshot date

installSmoke.label: E. Install smoke
proves: the recorded version installs into an isolated throwaway profile and boots keyless on the recorded host version, reaching MISSING_CREDENTIAL (tree-load proof), with a reproduction command

feedsGates.note: the recorded host accepted the recorded version at the recorded time; no gate evaluation or exemption is recorded
the tree loads; no per-row ACTIVE/disabled assertion is made

doesNotProve: that every target row is ACTIVE or disabled (G3)
that another host version admits it (G2)
that any feature works at runtime

securityVeto.label: Security veto
proves: no obfuscated code, credential exfiltration or surprising install-time behaviour was found in the reviewed artifact at the snapshot date
doesNotProve: an ENTRY gate (ENTRY explicitly does not audit security)
a CVE, sandbox or red-team result
that a clear veto means safe

entry.label: DSH-ENTRY
entry.analogy: GB (communication aid only; no legal force)

gates.requires: base + sample compose; inserted row names resolve
evaluatePluginCompatibility admits, or an explicit exact-version exemption applies
real boot(): every target row is ACTIVE or disabled
when dsh.client exists: exports['./client'] and a package-root row
report carries runtime version/commit/artifact mtime; stale evidence is marked stale
gates.note: the registry's own 30-day snapshot gate is a different clock: registry date vs today, not artifact mtime vs report

entry.note: A grade A-D is neither necessary nor sufficient for an ENTRY state. Security is not an ENTRY requirement, so the veto is a precondition of this repository's own claims only.

flow.label: DSH-FLOW
nearestAdjacent: installSmoke installs into a throwaway profile and prints the profile row: the install half of the install/remove journey, with no removal assertion and no journey state
manifest checks that five-language READMEs exist, not quickstart/permissions/error content
whatWouldBeNeeded: a journey record per J1-J8: command, environment, expected/actual, log path, timestamp, state
a harness that runs add/dump/remove, enable/disable, bad configuration, quickstart, permissions, upgrade/rollback/uninstall, diagnostics and headless/web client states in a throwaway DSH_HOME
a coverage rule where a skip is not a pass and a manual journey is labelled manual
a freshness rule for journey evidence
a submission format and gate change in this repository before any dsh-flow:* label appears
flow.note: The standards repository's own journey harness runs J1 only; J2-J8 are not-run there as well. Adjacency is not coverage.

boost.label: DSH-BOOST
boost.claim: guiding practice; evidence cards, no badge
nearestAdjacent: buildHygiene checks that lint/typecheck gates exist; that is not LEV-8 evidence
releaseIntegrity checks provenance; that is not LEV-6 prefix stability
installSmoke records a boot; that is not LEV-1 effect-baseline evidence
boost.evidenceCards: the standards repository: 33-DSH-BOOST加速实践.md section 4 defines the card; spec/levels.json lists LEV-1..LEV-8
whatWouldBeNeeded: one evidence card per practice: environment, input scale, command, negative control, result, version anchor, limitations
storage that lets the card be re-run, not prose
a rule that described is not measured and that a single run is not a production benchmark
a decision on whether this registry stores cards at all; today it has no place for them
boost.note: A practice card names a practice and a version; it is not a grade and not a badge, and it must never be attached to an entry as a level.

willNotClaim: that an A-D grade is a DSH level, or that ENTRY, FLOW or BOOST is a grade
an ENTRY runtime state from certification evidence alone
that installSmoke ok equals ENTRY runtime, or that a keyless boot equals a row-ACTIVE assertion
coverage of FLOW J1-J8 or of BOOST LEV-1..LEV-8
a security verdict from the security veto, the OpenSSF Scorecard or npm provenance
official status, DeepSeek endorsement, or compliance with GB, GB/T or GB/Z (the analogy has no legal force)
a combined score, ranking or ordering derived from a grade plus a level
that a stale snapshot describes the plugin as it is now

maintenance.note: Curated like the registry. scripts/check-freshness.mjs does not read this file, so it changes no grade and no gate; nothing catches drift, so review it by hand.
maintenance.syncRule: Change both sides in the same review. Never add coverage before the harness exists; never remove a not-covered because a grade is high.
